dominantPatterns.destructiveConfirmation: MUI Dialog (disableEscapeKeyDown) with common CONFIRM_TITLE header, a full-sentence localized question, Confirm (btn-primary) / Close (btn-secondary) actions, an in-dialog processing spinner and a result message. Sole destructive flow in the customer frontend: BookingList booking cancellation (CANCEL_BOOKING = 'Are you sure you want to cancel this booking?' en; fr/ar/es in booking-list.ts; result state CANCEL_BOOKING_REQUEST_SENT). Offered only when booking.cancellation && !cancelRequest && status != Cancelled && pickup date is in the future. Live note: the dev customer's bookings are past/non-cancellable, so the dialog was code-verified, not clicked; no cancellation was performed.
dominantPatterns.empty: Dedicated localized EMPTY_LIST card: CarList ('Pas de voitures.' / 'No cars.'), NotificationList ('Pas de notifications'), BookingList ('Pas de reservations.' via DataGrid empty state). Live-verified: search San Francisco (SFO) returns cars; search 'Location 1' returns the CarList empty card 'Pas de voitures.'.
dominantPatterns.error: Two channels, by kind: (1) fetch/action failures -> toast via helper.error() (react-toastify, common GENERIC_ERROR localized in fr/ar/en/es), used by CarList, BookingList, NotificationList, Avatar, DriverLicense, Map, Settings, ChangePassword, Booking, Contact/Newsletter (plus helper.info on success); (2) form-level server rejection -> inline <Error> component bound to RHF root error (SignIn ERROR_IN_SIGN_IN / IS_BLACKLISTED, SignUp SIGN_UP_ERROR + recaptchaError) or a dedicated error view (Checkout paymentFailed PAYMENT_FAILED, CheckoutSession status='error').
dominantPatterns.formValidation: DOMINANT PATTERN (reference implementation: SearchForm, fixed in slice A2): react-hook-form + zodResolver (mode 'onSubmit'), <form noValidate> so RHF - not the browser - owns validation, per-field MUI FormHelperText rendering the localized zod message (strings live in lang/common.ts and per-form lang files, 4 locales fr/ar/en/es), root/server errors via <Error> or toast. OUTLIER STATE BEFORE A3: SearchForm was the ONLY form in the app with noValidate (grep: 1 hit). Every other RHF form relied on HTML 'required' attributes, so an empty submit was blocked by the browser-native bubble and RHF never ran: baseline CDP evidence (fr) = 0 helper texts and 2-6 ':invalid' fields on sign-in, sign-up, contact, forgot-password and newsletter empty submits, while non-empty invalid values on sign-in DID show RHF helpers ('E-mail non valide', password-min). Secondary outliers: fields rendered with no error surface at all (SignUp fullName, Settings fullName, ContactForm subject/message had no FormHelperText), and schemas that accepted empty strings for UI-required fields (SignUp fullName/email/phone via z.string() and '!value ||' refines, Settings fullName, ContactForm subject/message).
dominantPatterns.loading: SimpleBackdrop with localized text (PLEASE_WAIT / LOADING) for page-level loads (Settings, SignUp submit, Booking, NotificationList, Bookings via BookingList), Progress/NProgressIndicator for list loads (CarList, Checkout page), DataGrid built-in loading for Bookings desktop, and disabled submit button + inline CircularProgress for small forms (ContactForm, NewsletterForm). No screen spins forever on a failed fetch in code: every fetch path clears loading in a finally/catch and toasts.
dominantPatterns.success: Toast via helper.info() is dominant for in-place actions (Settings SETTINGS_UPDATED incl. email-notification toggle, Contact MESSAGE_SENT, Newsletter SUCCESS, ChangePassword PASSWORD_UPDATE, Booking UPDATED common string). Dedicated success views where the flow ends: SignUp success panel, ForgotPassword EMAIL_SENT panel, Checkout/CheckoutSession CheckoutStatus success.

filedItems.reason: Checkout's form still lacks noValidate, guest fullName has no FormHelperText, and the guest schema fields are optional with '!value ||' refines: native 'required' is currently the ONLY empty-field enforcement for guests. Removing it without reworking the checkout schema/manual required logic (which interacts with authenticated vs guest branches, onBlur triggers and payment gating) would silently weaken checkout validation. A3's mandate for Checkout was the identical minimal ToS fix; the validation alignment should be its own slice with payment-flow regression tests. Not changed.
Non-RHF page with its own submit handler and toast feedback; no native-required text inputs, so no native-bubble defect. Migrating to RHF+zod would be a redesign, out of A3 scope.

Desktop DataGrid carries the localized EMPTY_LIST empty state; the mobile card variant renders rows only, with no explicit empty card when there are 0 bookings. Adding one is a UX addition needing mobile verification and a product call; not an objective silent-feedback defect on the primary layout.
Existing component design (icon actions + toast errors), consistent within NotificationList; adding a confirmation dialog is a UX change beyond objective incoherence.

fixes.evidence: Baseline fr: 0 helpers, 2-6 ':invalid' per form. After: fr+ar empty submits render localized helpers on sign-in, sign-up, forgot-password, contact, newsletter; settings and change-password verified signed-in.
fixes.rootCause: Forms used RHF+zod with per-field helpers but omitted noValidate (SearchForm/A2 was the only exception), so HTML 'required' attributes blocked submit with a browser-native bubble and RHF validation never ran on empty submits.
fixes.title: Align RHF forms to the dominant noValidate pattern

fixes.evidence: Code diff + live: contact empty submit now shows 3 helpers; sign-up empty shows fullName helper; settings cleared-fullName submit shows the required-field helper and does not save.
fixes.rootCause: These fields had no FormHelperText (and ContactForm's subject/message FormControls had no error prop), so even a fired RHF error was invisible.
fixes.title: Missing error surfaces: SignUp fullName, Settings fullName, ContactForm subject/message

fixes.evidence: Live fr+ar sign-up/contact empty submits show REQUIRED_FIELD in the active language; settings (account language en) shows 'Please fill in this field.'.
fixes.rootCause: fullName/subject/message were plain z.string() and SignUp email/phone used '!value ||' refines, so with native validation disabled the fields would have submitted empty silently. Added min(1) with a new common string REQUIRED_FIELD added to all 4 locales (fr 'Veuillez renseigner ce champ.', ar 'يرجى ملء هذا الحقل.', en 'Please fill in this field.', es 'Por favor, complete este campo.') and dropped the empty-accepting guards so empty email/phone report the existing EMAIL_NOT_VALID/PHONE_NOT_VALID.
fixes.title: Schemas accepted empty values for UI-required fields

fixes.evidence: First after-build showed the technical string in fr+ar sign-up helpers; after F4 it shows the localized REQUIRED_FIELD in fr+ar.
fixes.rootCause: z.date() with no message parameter produced zod v4's default 'Invalid input: expected date, received undefined' (English, technical) once RHF validation became reachable; now z.date({ message: commonStrings.REQUIRED_FIELD }).
fixes.title: BirthDate missing-value message was a raw zod technical string

fixes.evidence: LIVE guest checkout (Home search 'San Francisco Airport (SFO)' -> Reserver -> /checkout): link rect 387x24, computed display 'block', elementFromPoint at link center = the anchor; center click opened a new /tos tab, checkbox stayed unchecked, page stayed on /checkout; clicking the checkbox itself toggles it to checked. No checkout was submitted.
fixes.rootCause: Same pattern A2 fixed in SignUp.tsx: multi-line inline <Link> inside a table cell next to the ToS checkbox - clicks on the link's line box outside the text glyphs fell through, and propagation could toggle the checkbox. Applied the identical fix: onClick stopPropagation + sx display:block.
